blocks.text: Photographers and visual artists worldwide are invited to submit single images and photographic series for the third edition of the Chennai Photo Biennale International Photography Open Call, offering selected artists the opportunity to exhibit their work publicly in Chennai, India.
Open Call:

Submissions are open for Edition 3, 2026–27 of the Chennai Photo Biennale International Photography Open Call, an annual platform inviting photographers and artists worldwide to submit work for consideration by an international jury.

The call is open to anyone, from anywhere, working on any subject, with entries accepted across a wide range of photographic approaches. Applicants may submit either individual photographs or a cohesive photo series. Selected finalists will have their work produced and presented as part of a public exhibition in Chennai.
Institutional Context:

The CPB Foundation, a registered non-profit public trust based in Chennai, India, organises the International Photography Open Call and is dedicated to expanding engagement with photography and the photographic medium.

The Foundation also organises the Chennai Photo Biennale, an international photography festival held every two years in Chennai. Through exhibitions, education and public programmes, its activities create opportunities for photographers and audiences to engage with contemporary photographic practices from India and around the world.
Eligibility and Criteria:

The open call welcomes photographers of any age and from anywhere in the world, from amateur to professional practitioners. Applicants under 18 must provide consent from a parent or guardian. Individual artists, collaborative teams and groups may apply.

Submissions may explore fine art, documentary, portraiture, landscape, conceptual, experimental and other approaches to photography. Work that has previously been exhibited or published is eligible, provided the applicant holds the necessary rights.

Applicants may submit unlimited entries. Photo series must contain a minimum of 10 and a maximum of 20 images and should function as a cohesive body of work. Each submission must be accompanied by a concept note and/or captions.
AI-generated images are not accepted and will be disqualified. Video submissions are also not eligible.
Evaluation Process:
A diverse international jury of photographers, artists, curators, editors, and cultural professionals will review every submission.
The jury assesses entries on artistic merit, originality, technical excellence, and relevance to contemporary photographic discourse.

The 2026–27 jury includes practitioners and cultural figures such as Carine Dolek, Charan Singh, Yumi Goto, Danit Ariel, Katy Hundertmark, Ronny Sen, Sadaf Raza, Aditya Arya, Ana Casas Broda, Bhavna Kakar, Emmeline Yong, Senthil Kumaran, Umah Jacob, Ushmita Sahu, Venket Ram and Vineet Vohra, among others.
Successful applicants are expected to be notified in late December 2026.
Practical Information:

Selected finalists will receive print production and exhibition of their work in Chennai, alongside promotion through CPB’s digital campaigns, social media, email communications and print and digital partnerships. Selected artists will also receive a dedicated online feature through the Open Call website and CPB’s social channels.
Selected works may also be considered for travelling exhibitions and digital presentations at partner festivals. An extended shortlist will be presented digitally at the Open Call exhibition venue.

Submission fees vary according to location and entry type. For residents of India and South Asia, the fee is ₹300 for a single image and ₹700 for a photo series. For applicants from the rest of the world, the listed fees are €8 for a single image and €15 for a photo series. Students in India can apply at reduced rates: ₹100 for a single image and ₹200 for a photo series.

Applicants retain copyright and ownership of their work, while shortlisted and selected participants grant the organisers non-exclusive usage rights for purposes connected to the Open Call, the exhibition, the Chennai Photo Biennale, and related promotion.
Applications and Queries:
Submit applications through the Chennai Photo Biennale International Photography Open Call online platform by 31 October 2026.

Submit images according to the technical specifications in the official rules. Upload single-image entries as JPEG files, and submit photo series as a single ZIP file. Shortlisted photographers will subsequently be asked to provide original camera files and full-resolution processed TIFF files for printing.
